messages:
Priya (Procurement): quick vendor thread 12: BidHarbor sent a rate card + SOW for their cost-metering product. main concerns: credit mapping to tokens, rollover, and invoice line-items.
Amelia (Finance): skimmed it. they bill in 'compute credits' not tokens. we need a clear conversion and how overage is calculated.
Jon S (Eng Ops): for our POC we used ~1.2M inference tokens + ~45k embeddings across mixed sequence lengths. how would that translate?
Arjun - BidHarbor: thanks for the ping. commit = compute credits. baseline mapping: 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 10 embedding units. we can also publish token-first pricing if you prefer.
Sasha R (Platform): does the credit cost scale with sequence length? long-context requests will skew this.
Arjun - BidHarbor: yes — we apply a sequence multiplier for contexts >1024. e.g., 1024-4096 = 2x, 4097-8192 = 3. well share the full multiplier table.
Priya (Procurement): rollover behavior? last vendor expired all unused quarterly and it caused friction.
Arjun - BidHarbor: two commit flavors: quarterly (30% rollover) or annual (100% rollover with a small maintenance fee). both include monthly reconciliation statements.
Amelia (Finance): invoice cadence + payment terms? pilot needs net-45 ideally.
Arjun - BidHarbor: net-45 for pilots ok with PO up front, enterprise is net-30.
Jon S (Eng Ops): can we get per-request metering logs (token_in, token_out, model_variant) for reconciliation?
Arjun - BidHarbor: yes — CSV with request_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_units, timestamp. can push to your S3 or secure link.
Priya (Procurement): early termination / refunds? legal will ask.
Arjun - BidHarbor: 30-day termination. annual contracts pro-rata refund if >6 months remain, else no refund. open to negotiation for specific customers.
Sasha R (Platform): setup fee for Private VPC is $12k in the SOW. negotiable?
Arjun - BidHarbor: can reduce to $6k with 12mo annual commit.
Amelia (Finance): need a mock invoice for AP parser (credits used, overage lines, taxes).
Arjun - BidHarbor: attaching mock invoice example: "Quarterly commit (Q2) - 150,000 credits = $45,000", "Overage - 12,300 credits = $3,690", "Setup fee = $6,000". will share CSV + PDF.
Priya (Procurement): Accounting Bot please run parser on mock invoice and flag mappings.
Accounting Bot: copy that. drop CSV link and I'll do a dry run and post mapping diffs.
Jon S (Eng Ops): spot/discounted credits for best-effort batch jobs?
Arjun - BidHarbor: yes 12: spot credits at 35-45% discount depending on region/model. not for low-latency routes.
Sasha R (Platform): SOC2 + BYOK? we need customer-managed keys for Private.
Arjun - BidHarbor: SOC2 Type II available. BYOK via AWS KMS or HashiCorp supported for Private.
Priya (Procurement): proposed next steps: 1) Arjun posts multiplier table, 2) Accounting Bot runs invoice parse, 3) Amelia confirms net-45 pilot budget, 4) Sasha validates BYOK + spot applicability. ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack 12: will confirm budget ceiling by EOD tomorrow.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack 12: will test their CSV format with our 1.2M token sample and report parsing issues.
Sasha R (Platform): ack 12: will spin a POC to validate routing between spot and on-demand.
Arjun - BidHarbor: thanks 12: I'll push multiplier table + mock invoice in ~1hr. holding $6k setup concession for 48hrs. available for short sync. :handshake:
Accounting Bot: mock invoice received and queued for parse 12: will post results in ~2hrs.
